html: ## The sighting of `placed` on the segment at `from_rider`, if some of it shows ## over the horizon: its top, its kind's height above its lift and lowered ## by the ground's drop, is not hidden behind the curve of the ground. Every ## kind with a height takes this test here. sighting_above_horizon_of : Geom.Placed(kind), { road : RoadAhead.RoadView, vantage : Geom.Vantage, from_rider : SegmentFromRider, } -> Try(Pipeline.Sighted(kind), [OutOfSight]) where [kind.scenery_height : kind -> Distance] sighting_above_horizon_of = |placed, { road, vantage, from_rider }| { sighting = sighting_of(placed, { road, vantage, from_rider })? spot = sighting.spot top = spot.lift().plus(placed.kind.scenery_height()).minus(spot.drop()) if EarthCurve.is_below_horizon({ point: spot.foot().to_rider(), top }) { Err(OutOfSight) } else { Ok(sighting) } }

It is one of the ## four things each step carries to the next. import Steps Clock :: U32.{ ## The clock as a ride starts. start : Clock start = Clock.(0) ## The clock at step `number` of a ride. at_step : U32 -> Clock at_step = |number| Clock.(number) ## The clock one step on. next : Clock -> Clock next = |Clock.(n)| Clock.(n + 1) ## How many steps this clock is past `earlier`. It crashes when this clock ## comes before `earlier`. steps_since : Clock, Clock -> Steps steps_since = |Clock.(n), Clock.(earlier)| if n < earlier { crash "Clock.steps_since: this clock comes before the one it counts from" } else { Steps.of(n - earlier) } ## The clock `length` steps on. plus : Clock, Steps -> Clock plus = |Clock.(n), length| Clock.(n + length.to_u32()) ## The clock `length` steps back. It crashes when that would go back past ## step 0, where the ride starts. minus : Clock, Steps -> Clock minus = |Clock.(n), length| { back = length.to_u32() if back > n { crash "Clock.minus: the ride starts at step 0, and nothing comes before it" } else { Clock.(n - back) } } is_lt : Clock, Clock -> Bool is_lt = |Clock.(n), Clock.(other)| n < other to_str : Clock -> Str to_str = |Clock.(n)| n.to_str() is_eq : _ } expect Clock.at_step(9).steps_since(Clock.at_step(9)) == Steps.zero expect Clock.at_step(9).steps_since(Clock.at_step(8)) == Steps.one_step expect Clock.at_step(9).steps_since(Clock.start) == Steps.of(9) expect Clock.start.next().steps_since(Clock.start) == Steps.one_step expect Clock.start.plus(Steps.zero) == Clock.start expect Clock.at_step(9).plus(Steps.of(3)) == Clock.at_step(12) expect Clock.at_step(9).minus(Steps.zero) == Clock.at_step(9) expect Clock.at_step(9).minus(Steps.of(3)) == Clock.at_step(6) expect Clock.at_step(9).minus(Steps.of(9)) == Clock.start expect Clock.at_step(8) < Clock.at_step(9) expect !(Clock.at_step(9) < Clock.at_step(9)) expect !(Clock.at_step(10) < Clock.at_step(9))

html: ## The tease: where the truck aims to be along the route when the rider is ## `rider_distance` along it, so that the rider closes in on it over the whole ## route. The lead it aims for shrinks from `tease_start_lead` to ## `tease_finish_lead` in step with the rider's progress. The truck only chases ## this mark, and never slows to keep to it, so the real gap closes unevenly: the ## truck can run past the mark on a straight, and it slows for the bends. tease_position : { rider_distance : Distance, route_length : Distance } -> Distance tease_position = |{ rider_distance, route_length }| { fraction_left = 1.0 - rider_distance.ratio_to(route_length) extra_lead = tease_start_lead.minus(tease_finish_lead).times(fraction_left) rider_distance.plus(tease_finish_lead).plus(extra_lead) }

html: ## The start of an animation that is to end as the rider comes within ## `ends_at`, planned at `now` from how the rider comes then: `gap` from the ## animal, at `speed`. html: ## The whole of a crossing, a frame a step: the cat walks out to the middle ## of the road, freezes there, and leaps clear to the far verge. crossing_timeline : CatCrossing -> Animation.Timeline(CrossingFrame, CatCrossing.CatPose) crossing_timeline = |crossing| { on_road = |across| { road_point: { along: crossing.along(), across }, lift: Distance.zero } start = on_road(crossing.start_across()) middle = on_road(CatCrossing.mid_across) end = on_road(CatCrossing.end_across) location_of = |way| match way { WalkingOut(fraction) => Animation.location_between({ from: start, to: middle, fraction }) StandingFrozen => middle Leaping({ way_to_verge, lift }) => { on_the_way = Animation.location_between({ from: middle, to: end, fraction: way_to_verge, }) { ..on_the_way, lift } } } Animation.Timeline.of({ before: { pose: Rest, location: start }, frames: crossing_frames, frame_instant: |{ pose, way }| { pose, location: location_of(way) }, after: { pose: Collapse, location: end }, }) }

html: ## The whole of a flight: `flight_frames`, on one smooth path that rises in ## the middle, from the tip of the tree it leaves to the tip of the one it ## lands on. flight_timeline : BirdFlight -> Animation.Timeline(FlightFrame, BirdFlight.BirdPose) flight_timeline = |{ from, to }| { ends = { from: tree_top(from), to: tree_top(to) } Animation.Timeline.of({ before: sitting_on(from), frames: flight_frames, frame_instant: |{ pose, through }| { pose, location: flight_location({ from: ends.from, to: ends.to, through }), }, after: sitting_on(to), }) }

html: ## The location `through` a flight between `from` and `to`, easing out and in along ## a straight line, and raised by an arc over it. flight_location : { from : Animation.Location, to : Animation.Location, through : Fraction, } -> Animation.Location flight_location = |{ from, to, through }| { on_line = Animation.location_between({ from, to, fraction: Easing.smoothstep(through) }) share = through.to_f64() # 4t(1 - t) is 0 at both ends and 1 halfway, so the arc tops out at `flight_arc`. above_line = flight_arc.times(4.0 * share * (1.0 - share)) { ..on_line, lift: on_line.lift.plus(above_line) } }

html: ## A point on the segment at `position` on the road ahead, carried back round ## each bend between it and the rider's segment, as the camera at `vantage` ## there sees it. rider_point_round_bends : RoadAhead.RoadView, { vantage : Geom.Vantage, position : SegmentFromRider.Position, road_point : Geom.RoadPoint, } -> RiderView.RiderPoint rider_point_round_bends = |road, { vantage, position, road_point }| { bends = bends_ahead(road) var $point = road_point var $bends_left = position.to_u32().to_u64() while $bends_left > 0 { $bends_left = $bends_left - 1 bend = bends.get($bends_left) ?? crash "RoadAhead.rider_point_round_bends: past the road's end" $point = Geom.point_before_worked_bend($point, bend) } to_rider_point($point, vantage) }

html: ## `point`, on the segment after a bend already worked out, measured on the ## segment before it instead: turned by the bend, and moved to where the ## segment after starts. point_before_worked_bend : Geom.RoadPoint, Geom.WorkedBend -> Geom.RoadPoint point_before_worked_bend = |point, { start_after: start, cos_turn, sin_turn }| { along = point.along.to_metres() across = point.across.to_metres() { along: start.along.plus(Distance.metres(cos_turn * along - sin_turn * across)), across: start.across.plus(Distance.metres(sin_turn * along + cos_turn * across)), } }

html: ## A point on the rider's segment, as the camera at `vantage` sees it. to_rider_point : Geom.RoadPoint, Geom.Vantage -> RiderView.RiderPoint to_rider_point = |{ along, across }, vantage| { ahead = along.distance_from(vantage.along).to_metres() aside = across.distance_from(vantage.across).to_metres() cos_yaw = vantage.yaw.to_radians().cos() sin_yaw = vantage.yaw.to_radians().sin() { forward: Distance.metres(ahead * cos_yaw + aside * sin_yaw), right: Distance.metres((0.0 - ahead) * sin_yaw + aside * cos_yaw), } }
